fact: The Attorney General's August 2022 investigation found 8,690 citizens drawing salaries under national numbers that do not exist in the civil registry system, showing public payroll is keyed on the national number.

The Attorney General's August 2022 investigation reported 88,819 incorrect national numbers, including 63,986 forged numbers absent from the civil registry system and 8,690 people paid salaries under such numbers.

The Attorney General's investigations announced on 17 August 2022 found 8,690 citizens drawing salaries under national numbers that were forged and not in the civil registry system, showing public payroll keyed on the national number.
The Attorney General announced on 17 August 2022 that checking the national number system found 88,819 incorrect numbers, 63,986 of them absent from the civil registry system.
